accounts.name: What changed and why it matters

queue.body:
Jobless claims averaging 199k a week, 12.8% below a year ago.
GDPNow tracking 5.8% annual growth this quarter.
Median CPI running 2.1% annual rate.
Soft landing isn't a forecast anymore, it's the print.

accounts.name: Crowd translator — market psychology, mood vs positioning, consumer and tech stories with market consequence

queue.body:
$TTC held 99.6 today, the level it bounced from in February.
That was the last time the weekly chart looked this constructive, before it ran to 123.
A close below 84.2 and the whole pattern was noise.

accounts.name: Mechanism detective — cross-asset disagreement, what moved first, what is already priced, and the missing denominator

queue.body:
jobless claims 199k, down 12.8% from a year ago
gdpnow 5.8%
median cpi 2.1%
the labor market is tight, growth is hot, and inflation is already calm. the uncomfortable mix is the one nobody is pricing.
